name: Form Threshing
implementation_notes: REVISED 2026-08-24 (entity-catalog v12, replacing the original fixed 24-row design the user explicitly rejected as wasting screen space): Threshing Detail grid now renders whatever rows exist (0..24) loaded from threshingRecordRepo.getDraftWithDetails(), with Tambah baris/Hapus baris controls -- the exact same dynamic add-row/remove-row pattern as Cages Tipped Time (screen-012), no longer a structural difference from that grid

Target Operasional reference table sourced from a STATIC constant (mobile/src/data/threshingOperationalTargets.ts, created under screen-037) rather than a synced local reference table -- judgment call, documented in that file's own header comment and repeated here: building a third local-reference-sync mechanism (after station/mill_setting) for 6 rarely-changing rows was judged out of proportion; if Admin edits these values via web in the future, mobile needs an app update to reflect it

'Minimal 1 baris valid' (Time-Slot terpilih + minimal 1 kolom bacaan terisi) validated at FE + repo level (threshingRecordRepo.saveDraft() throws ThreshingDetailRequiredError) -- NOT enforced by the server model's ThreshingRecord::booted() saving guard, which only checks row EXISTENCE (now meaningfully true only once the user has added at least one row, since rows are no longer pre-created)

availableTimeSlotOptions() compares slots by their index in canonicalTimeSlots() rather than a raw hour number (since slots wrap starting at 07:00, not 0-23) -- the one structural difference from Cages Tipped Time's availableHourOptions(), otherwise the floor/exclusion logic is identical

Every FormField id in the grid is set explicitly (e.g. ffb-throughput-{index}) to avoid duplicate DOM ids across rows sharing the same label text -- FormField.vue's default id-from-label slug would otherwise collide

REVISI (tech-spec v3, kunci periode usecase-141 — sinkronisasi artefak): FormThreshingView menyimpan ke SQLite lokal tanpa memeriksa periode; satu-satunya panggilan server dari form ini adalah write-through syncAfterSave('threshing_record') → pushSavedRecordNow → POST /api/threshing-records bila Mills Setting immediate_sync_enabled aktif. Penolakannya (termasuk 422 PERIOD_CLOSED) sejak 2026-10-03 ditampilkan langsung di form (lihat catatan REVISI 2026-10-03); di sinkron manual screen-006 alasannya tampil per record di SyncResultDialog. Guard EnforcesPeriodLock::assertPeriodOpenForWrite('threshing', mill, date) di ThreshingRecordService::create() menilai periode saat request tiba (bukan saat dicatat). Form hanya membuka draft lokal; tidak ada jalur edit/PATCH record tersinkron dari mobile. Cakupan: backend/tests/Unit/Support/EnforcesPeriodLockTest.php (aturan whitelist + 'ke-18 *RecordService memanggil guard pada create MAUPUN update'), backend/tests/Feature/Api/KelolaPeriodePelaporanTest.php ('menolak 422 PERIOD_CLOSED untuk data mobile yang menyusul, lalu menerimanya setelah periode dibuka kembali'), mobile/tests/syncService.spec.ts (gagal per record dengan reason dari server, galat generik), dan mobile/tests/writeThroughSync.spec.ts.

REVISI (2026-10-03): penolakan write-through kini ditampilkan — writeThroughSync.syncAfterSave() mengembalikan {synced, rejection}; respons server 4xx (mis. 422 PERIOD_CLOSED) mengisi rejection dengan pesan server, sedangkan offline/5xx/fitur nonaktif tetap {synced:false, rejection:null} dan diam. onSimpan() menyimpan pesan itu ke writeThroughRejection, menampilkan ConfirmDialog satu tombol (cancel-label="") berjudul 'Tersimpan, tetapi ditolak server' dengan pesan server, dan baru bernavigasi ke monitor-threshing saat dialog ditutup (Mengerti atau klik overlay). Record tetap 'saved' di SQLite lokal, tidak ada rollback; dapat dikirim ulang lewat Sinkronisasi setelah periode dibuka kembali. Test: mobile/tests/writeThroughSync.spec.ts ('reports the server message when the push is rejected with 422 PERIOD_CLOSED' + kasus diam) dan mobile/tests/FormThreshingView.spec.ts ('shows the server rejection before leaving when write-through saving is refused').

REVISI (2026-10-03, run penuh Playwright mobile 430 lulus / 0 gagal): mobile/tests/e2e/form-threshing.spec.ts 9/9 lulus — kini dijalankan nyata (known_issue 'tidak dapat dijalankan di sandbox' dihapus). Perbaikan spec (drift, bukan cacat aplikasi): tabel Target Operasional berada di CollapsibleSection yang tertutup secara default (disengaja, 2026-08-25) — spec kini membukanya dulu sebelum meng-assert isi tabel.

REVISI (2026-10-04, audit-fix — sinkronisasi artefak, kode adalah acuan): threshingRecordRepo.createDraft() menyimpan date = todayLocalDateString() (mobile/src/utils/localDate.ts; sebelumnya ISO UTC → draft 00:00–06:59 WIB bertanggal kemarin, counter 'Hari Ini' meleset); FormThreshingView: catatan berlabel 'Catatan' dengan id field-note. Write-through syncAfterSave() kini benar-benar berjalan saat immediate_sync_enabled aktif karena millSettingRepo.getMillSetting() men-SELECT immediate_sync_enabled (sebelumnya selalu false). Payload sinkron (manual & write-through) mengirim date lokal dan production line stasiun record; 4xx menulis sync_error (Data Preview 'Gagal sinkron'), sukses mengosongkannya. ConfirmDialog (termasuk dialog penolakan write-through) di-teleport ke <body>. Server ThreshingRecordService menolak date > besok. Cakupan baru: localDate.sqljs.spec.ts (createDraft threshing 01:30 WIB), writeThroughSync.spec.ts (disesuaikan), millSettingRepo.sqljs.spec.ts (SELECT immediate_sync_enabled), syncService.sqljs.spec.ts (#4 date lokal, #5 line, #9 sync_error), noteLabelConsistency.spec.ts, DialogTeleport.spec.ts.
